messages:
Alex W.: Heads-up: QuantaCloud sent INV-7824 but the PDF has no PO on the header. It9s in the AP queue blocked. Anyone know which PO this should hit or who signs off on the extra services?
Priya S.: I pulled the attachment. There's a CSV with line-level details. Looks like subscription + 12 consulting hours. No PO printed.
Marcus L.: Could be PO 2024-PLAT-09 for the subscription only; that PO does not include ad-hoc consulting.
Elaine (AP): We can auto-match the subscription lines if you attach PO 2024-PLAT-09. For the consult hours AP needs a cost-owner approval or a PO amendment. Who owns the services spend?
Priya S.: @Marcus L. and @Rohit split ownership. Marcus, can you confirm or provide approval language we can attach?
Marcus L.: I approve the consulting charges. Please add this exact note to the invoice record: "Marcus L. approves QuantaCloud INV-7824 professional services, GL=6102, cost center=PLAT-OPS."
Elaine (AP): That wording is fine. AP requires the approval text in Concur or attached to the invoice for audit trail. Also, confirm the GL split per vendor CSV — they had a two-line split, do we allocate 70/30 across 6102/6103?
Alex W.: I uploaded a screenshot of Marcus's note and added the comment to the invoice record. I also added a line-note: 70% GL 6102, 30% GL 6103.
finance-bot: Invoice INV-7824 status updated: "requires-approver-attachment" -> "manual-review". Approver: Marcus L.
Elaine (AP): OK. Priya can you check PO 2024-PLAT-09 period coverage? If it matches invoice dates we can attach it and release the subscription portion. If not, we need a PO amendment or to mark subscription as prepaid.
Priya S.: Checked — PO 2024-PLAT-09 covers Apr-Nov 2024. Invoice date Sep 2024 is within period. Uploading PO PDF to invoice record now.
Marcus L.: Confirmed match. Subscription matched to PO 2024-PLAT-09 and consulting charges approved as noted. Please proceed with approval routing.
Elaine (AP): Attached PO, approver note, GL mapping. Marking INV-7824 for payment in next AP run. ETA: 3 business days. :white_check_mark:
Alex W.: Thanks all. I'll message the vendor contact to request PO printed on future invoices (include 2024-PLAT-09 on header).
Marcus L.: Will follow up with vendor regarding invoice header.
Priya S.: Closing here, will reopen if AP flags anything else.
